title: Focus-sync prep — Isabella Park & report
content:
Meeting: weekly focus-sync (one-on-one)
Date/time: 2026-08-17 10:00am PT (30m) — Zoom
Goal for this meeting: short, tactical unblock + one directional career signal.

Context / quick state
- Report (A) is the primary owner for micro-batching work and the cross-team perf test harness.
- Sprint: target to land JIRA-4821 (kv-cache merge) by end of sprint. PR linked above is currently in review and flaky on integration tests.
- Signals: fewer PR reviews from A this week; late merge on infra test; mentions they are on-call next week.
- Mood: sounded tired in Slack yesterday — likely context switch fatigue.

Top objectives for this 30m
1) Unblock kv-cache PR and integration test flakiness (technical, short-term).
2) Surface workload and bandwidth constraints (how much time left for project work).
3) Career micro-coaching: run two calibration questions around impact and scope expansion.
4) Agree explicit next steps with owners and deadlines.

Proposed agenda (timeboxed)
- 0:00–03: Check-in: how are you feeling? (psych safety, energy) — set tone.
- 03–12: Wins + blockers (ask: what would make this week better?)
- 12–22: Deep-dive: kv-cache test flakiness — root-cause hypotheses, short experiments, who to rope in.
- 22–28: Career pulse (two calibration questions + ask about career goals this quarter).
- 28–30: Action items + recap.

Manager prompts / targeted questions
- On the PR: "What's the smallest experiment that would prove/disprove the flakiness hypothesis?"
- On bandwidth: "How many focused hours per week can you realistically protect for feature work?" (get a number: 6–10 etc)
- On escalation: "Who should I pull in to help debug (infra/SRE/QA)?" — offer a specific name and time.
- Career: "If you could pick one area to grow this quarter (system design, mentorship, cross-team influence), which would move you toward your 6–12 month goal?"

Hypotheses for test flakiness (prepare to validate during meeting)
- Integration test is timing-sensitive around sequence length distribution -> kick off a small repro with shorter seqs.
- Race condition in cache eviction when concurrent requests hit new path.
- Environment mismatch between CI and dev images (different kernel/lib versions).
Actionable experiments (quick wins)
- Run flaky job locally with K=10 random seeds, capture logs (owner: A, due: EOD today).
- Add targeted assertion in test to surface where it fails (owner: A + reviewer: Liam, due: tomorrow AM).
- If still failing, schedule 1-hour debug slot with infra (owner: Isabella to set up, due: tomorrow).

Career calibration — two quick exercises
1) Impact anchor: ask A to pick 2 outcomes from last quarter they are most proud of and describe the impact (metrics, people, velocity).
2) Scope stretch: propose one stretch assignment (owning rollout of micro-batching to dedicated customers) — watch for enthusiasm + risk tolerance.

Coaching/phrases to use
- "Tell me about the decision tradeoffs you made on X." (encourage reflection)
- "What part of this makes you excited vs frustrated?" (surface motivators)
- "If you had an extra half-day this week, what would you spend it on?" (prioritization)

Signals to watch for (escalation heuristics)
- If A reports less than 4 focused hours per week for feature work for two consecutive weeks -> spin up resource/tempo discussion with PD.
- If blocking spans >48 hours with no mitigation -> escalate to SRE lead / tech lead.

Parking lot (if time allows)
- Revisit on-call load balancing for next rotation.
- Mentorship pairing request (Rita suggested a 4-week pairing with Kunal on system design) — confirm interest.

Action items (post-meeting template to fill)
- Create JIRA subtask for targeted test repro (owner: A; due: 2026-08-14)
- Add reviewers to PR and call out flaky test line in PR description (owner: A; due: 2026-08-14)
- Isabella to schedule 1-hour debug session with infra/SRE if test still failing by tomorrow noon (owner: Isabella; due: 2026-08-15)
- If bandwidth <6 hours/week, set up 30m cadence with manager to re-prioritize work (owner: Isabella + A; due: 2026-08-18)

Notes-to-self (manager)
- Be explicit about tradeoffs: protecting focus time vs shipping schedule.
- Offer to block review time for A this sprint (I can take 1hr to review PRs).
- Follow up on Rita's mentorship suggestion and propose 2x 1-hour pairing slots next week.

Open questions for meeting follow-up
- Will infra be available for debugging tomorrow? (I should check calendar and ping SRE lead)
- Does A want public recognition for last quarter's perf win (ops savings)?

Quick exportable recap I can paste in Slack after meeting:
- "Recap: we ran experiments to repro flaky integration test (JIRA-4821). A will produce a repro and add targeted assertions by EOD; I will schedule infra debug if still failing tomorrow. We agreed to protect X hours/week for focused work and to re-evaluate on 8/18. Action items: JIRA subtask created, PR updated with test notes, debug meeting pending."
